name: Smoke Exit
description: Alone on an empty stage under one spotlight, the subject unravels into black smoke and drifts away.

wardrobe.man: a black three-piece suit and a black shirt
wardrobe.woman: a fitted black velvet dress and a long black coat

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands alone at the center of an empty wooden theatre stage under a single hard white spotlight from directly above, wearing {wardrobe}, hands relaxed at the sides, facing the camera. Deep red velvet curtains hang in the darkness behind, a thin haze floats in the beam, and the edges of the frame fall into black. Medium-wide shot at eye level from the front of the stage, the {subject} centered, full body in the pool of light. Cinematic low-key photography, hard top light, deep blacks, warm dust glowing in the beam. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain velvet curtains and a bare stage throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the spotlight, chin slightly raised, eyes on a point just past the camera. One slow blink, and starting at the hem of the clothes and the ends of the hair the body unravels into thick black smoke that pours upward and to the left in heavy rolling plumes; the unravelling climbs the legs, the torso and finally the face, until by the last second only a column of dense black smoke drifts out of the spotlight to the left and the pool of light on the stage is empty. The camera holds a steady medium-wide shot and drifts very slightly to the left with the smoke. Sound: a low airy whoosh, a soft hiss like a snuffed candle, the faint creak of the stage boards. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, thick volumetric smoke with real weight and curl, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame stays still. Starting at the edges of the clothes and the hair, the body unravels into thick black smoke that pours upward and away to one side in heavy rolling plumes, until by the last second only a column of dense black smoke drifts out of frame and the place where the {subject} stood is empty. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a low airy whoosh, a soft hiss like a snuffed candle. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, thick volumetric smoke with real weight and curl, sharp detail, stable picture.
